buildCommand: if [ "$FLUTTER_DEMO_MODE" = "true" ]; then flutter/bin/flutter build web --release --dart-define=FLUTTER_DEMO_MODE=true --pwa-strategy=none; else flutter/bin/flutter build web --release --pwa-strategy=none; fi
installCommand: npm install && git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git --depth 1 -b stable && flutter/bin/flutter doctor && flutter/bin/flutter pub get
